description: X25519 ECDH + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM per-session data encryption key; raw DEK never leaves device; buyer public key bound.

name: Escrow auto-refund on DEK non-delivery
description: 48-hour escrow timeout; idempotent ESCROW_REFUND + credit clawback emitted automatically when seller fails to deliver DEK.

name: Per-MIME artifact quality validators
description: Structural validators for image magic bytes, CSV column consistency, PDF BT-block presence, JSON non-empty, Python non-blank lines, ZIP member count.

name: Node MIME auto-calibration and replication priority
description: Per-node MIME frequency tracking from audit rows; normalised weights drive replication priority; policy gate checked first; bootstrap signal from own grants.

name: Multi-node chunk concentration hijack guard
description: Detects co-registered peer clusters holding > 1/3 of RS chunks or >= n_parity+1 slots; blocks registration and emits penalty.

name: NFT/crypto chain adapter bridge
description: ChainAdapter ABC with NullAdapter stub; going live = implement subclass + set config key; emits chain-aware audit rows for mint, on-ramp, off-ramp, verify.

name: Asset lineage enforcement (ALE)
description: Exact SHA-256 fingerprint, perceptual dHash, Winnowing shingle, and LLM-peer SIMILARITY_CHECK layers; per-member decompose loop kills dilution attack; zero-novelty hard block.

name: Asset provenance staking (APS)
description: 30-day challenge window; mint stake locked; slash on successful challenge; provenance_compensation CREDIT_DELTA to base owner.

name: Multi-deliverer proportional fee routing
description: Delivery graph tracks replica holders per feature; fee split proportional to delivery count; delivery_fee CREDIT_DELTA per seeder.

name: Executor reference price auto-derivation and MVP floor
description: Derives reference price from median ledger fills; minimum viable price = production + bandwidth + protocol_fee; ask_price auto-adjusted upward; cheaper-than-executor enforced by protocol.

name: Ledger block sealer reward
description: CREDIT_DELTA(seal_reward, 1 unit) emitted after each LEDGER_BLOCK_SEAL; funded by 2% protocol fee treasury; configurable via seal_reward_units.

name: LLM peer similarity-check reward
description: CREDIT_DELTA(llm_peer_reward, 2 units) emitted per SIMILARITY_VERDICT; deduped per checker per feature; funded by protocol fee treasury.

name: 8-decimal satoshi credit accounting
description: DECIMALS=8, UNIT=10^8; EMA velocity multiplier; Wilson reputation scoring; chain bridge constants CHAIN_DECIMALS=18, CHAIN_SCALE=10^10.

name: Semantic synonym expansion for feature discovery
description: Synonym map (chart<->visualization, model<->llm, data<->dataset, etc.) expands query tokens in _semantic_score; cache-hit path injects p2p_suggestions.

name: Buyer quarantine receipt acknowledgement

name: Paired value rubric measurement

name: Paired cost receipt

name: Adapter-driven live P2P paired runner

name: Local-only synthetic P2P cohort

name: Intent-to-asset ranking

name: Actionable-intent discovery gate

name: Held-out P2P retrieval benchmark
